/**
 * Writes the committed fixtures `fixtures/log-0.3.0/` with the 0.3.0 writer. Run it in a checkout of the tag `atm-v0.3.0`
 * (it needs that release's `handleStripeEvent`, grants rules and test helpers), with TZ=UTC:
 *
 *   git archive atm-v0.3.0 packages/atm | tar -x -C <scratch>   # then link node_modules, and copy this file to fixtures/
 *   TZ=UTC bun fixtures/gen-log-030.ts <out dir>
 *
 * Per scenario it writes `events.jsonl` (what the writer put in the log: `result.events` in order, plus the family's own
 * bookings), `commands.json` (every engine command the writer ran, with the whole mutation the engine decided: the
 * oracle, most of which the log does not hold) `state.json` (the engine's rows as the stored rows ended) and `rows.json` (all the stored rows and the revision,
 * to carry on from).
 */
import { mock } from "bun:test";
import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";

const out = process.argv[2];
if (!out) throw new Error("usage: bun fixtures/gen-log-030.ts <out dir>");

const ran: { command: unknown; mutation: unknown }[] = [];
const original = { ...(await import("../src/ledger/run.js")) };
mock.module("../src/ledger/run.js", () => ({
	...original,
	runOnState: (input: Parameters<typeof original.runOnState>[0]) => {
		const result = original.runOnState(input);
		ran.push({ command: input.command, mutation: result.mutation });
		return result;
	},
}));

const { menuCatalogRows } = await import("../src/billing/grants.js");
const { stateFromRows } = await import("../src/billing/rows.js");
const { addonPriceKey, lookupKeyOf, tierPriceKey } = await import(
	"../src/billing/stripe-menu.js"
);
const { mutationToEvents } = await import("../src/ledger/postings.js");
const { canonicalize } = await import("../src/ledger/util.js");
const { createStore } = await import("../tests/billing-store.js");
const { invoicePaid, subscriptionDeleted } = await import(
	"../tests/stripe-events.js"
);
type Menu = import("../src/billing/types.js").Menu;

const SCHOOL = "sch_vol";
const FAMILY = "fam_old";
const menu = JSON.parse(
	readFileSync(
		join(import.meta.dir, "billing/grants/menu.json"),
		"utf8",
	),
) as Menu;
const metadata = { b4u_school: SCHOOL, family_id: FAMILY };
const T0 = Date.parse("2026-01-15T18:00:00Z");
const T1 = Date.parse("2026-02-15T18:00:00Z");
const T2 = Date.parse("2026-03-15T18:00:00Z");
const DAY = 86_400_000;

const priceOf = (tierId: string) =>
	menu.tiers
		.find((t) => t.id === tierId)
		?.prices.find((p) => p.interval === "month")?.amount as number;
const tierLine = (tierId: string) => ({
	lookupKey: lookupKeyOf(
		SCHOOL,
		tierPriceKey(tierId, "month"),
		priceOf(tierId),
		menu.currency,
	),
	amount: priceOf(tierId),
	interval: "month" as const,
});
const giftLine = (addonId: string) => {
	const addon = menu.addons.find((a) => a.id === addonId) as Menu["addons"][number];
	return {
		lookupKey: lookupKeyOf(
			SCHOOL,
			addonPriceKey(addon.id, addon.price.every, addon.gift),
			addon.price.amount,
			menu.currency,
		),
		amount: addon.price.amount,
	};
};
const payment = (
	tierId: string,
	reason: "subscription_create" | "subscription_cycle",
	start: number,
	end: number,
	invoice: string,
) =>
	invoicePaid({
		eventId: `evt_${invoice}`,
		invoiceId: invoice,
		at: start + 10_000,
		subscriptionId: "sub_1",
		reason,
		periodStart: start,
		periodEnd: end,
		lines: [tierLine(tierId)],
		metadata,
	});

type Store = ReturnType<typeof createStore>;
const identityOf = (store: Store) => ({
	orgId: SCHOOL,
	env: "live",
	customerId: store.holder,
	entityId: null,
});
/** The family service logs its own command as it runs it; the 0.3.0 test store does not, so this does. */
const spendAndLog = (store: Store, units: number, at: number) => {
	const before = stateFromRows({
		identity: identityOf(store),
		revision: store.revision,
		rows: store.rows,
	});
	store.spend(units, at);
	const mutation = ran.at(-1)?.mutation as never;
	store.events.push(
		...mutationToEvents({
			mutation,
			context: {
				school: SCHOOL,
				tz: menu.timeZone,
				feature: "visit",
				reason: "visit taken",
				before: before as never,
			},
		}),
	);
};
const scenarios: Record<string, (store: Store) => void> = {
	"sparkle-4-create": (store) => {
		store.handle(
			payment("sparkle-4", "subscription_create", T0, T1, "in_1"),
			T0 + 10_000,
		);
	},
	"sparkle-2-year": (store) => {
		store.handle(
			payment("sparkle-2", "subscription_create", T0, T1, "in_1"),
			T0 + 10_000,
		);
		store.handle(
			payment("sparkle-2", "subscription_cycle", T1, T2, "in_2"),
			T1 + 10_000,
		);
		store.handle(
			subscriptionDeleted({
				eventId: "evt_sd",
				subscriptionId: "sub_1",
				tierId: "sparkle-2",
				interval: "month",
				periodStart: T1,
				periodEnd: T2,
				at: T1 + DAY,
			}),
			T1 + DAY,
		);
	},
	// the cycle-end update is not a no-op after a month end: the engine steps Feb 28 to Mar 28, Stripe bills Mar 31
	// (the third write, Mar 31, is the new writer's in the tests)
	"sparkle-2-month-end": (store) => {
		const jan31 = Date.parse("2026-01-31T18:00:00Z");
		const feb28 = Date.parse("2026-02-28T18:00:00Z");
		const mar31 = Date.parse("2026-03-31T18:00:00Z");
		store.handle(
			payment("sparkle-2", "subscription_create", jan31, feb28, "in_1"),
			jan31 + 10_000,
		);
		store.handle(
			payment("sparkle-2", "subscription_cycle", feb28, mar31, "in_2"),
			feb28 + 10_000,
		);
	},
	// a dollar gift writes the grants row alone; the family spends a visit (logged by the family service as it ran)
	"sparkle-2-gift-spend": (store) => {
		store.handle(
			payment("sparkle-2", "subscription_create", T0, T1, "in_1"),
			T0 + 10_000,
		);
		store.handle(
			invoicePaid({
				eventId: "evt_gift",
				invoiceId: "in_gift",
				at: T0 + 2 * DAY,
				subscriptionId: null,
				reason: "manual",
				periodStart: T0 + 2 * DAY,
				periodEnd: T0 + 2 * DAY,
				lines: [giftLine("gift-dollars")],
				metadata,
			}),
			T0 + 2 * DAY,
		);
		spendAndLog(store, 1, T0 + 3 * DAY);
		store.handle(
			payment("sparkle-2", "subscription_cycle", T1, T2, "in_2"),
			T1 + 10_000,
		);
	},
};

const catalog = menuCatalogRows({ menu, school: SCHOOL });
mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
writeFileSync(join(out, "catalog.json"), `${JSON.stringify(catalog, null, "\t")}\n`);

for (const [name, run] of Object.entries(scenarios)) {
	ran.length = 0;
	const store = createStore({ menu, school: SCHOOL, family: FAMILY });
	run(store);
	const dir = join(out, name);
	mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
	writeFileSync(
		join(dir, "events.jsonl"),
		`${store.events.map((e) => canonicalize(e)).join("\n")}\n`,
	);
	writeFileSync(
		join(dir, "commands.json"),
		`${JSON.stringify(ran, null, "\t")}\n`,
	);
	const state = stateFromRows({
		identity: {
			orgId: SCHOOL,
			env: "live",
			customerId: store.holder,
			entityId: null,
		},
		revision: store.revision,
		rows: store.rows,
	});
	writeFileSync(
		join(dir, "rows.json"),
		`${JSON.stringify({ revision: store.revision, rows: store.rows }, null, "\t")}\n`,
	);
	writeFileSync(join(dir, "state.json"), `${JSON.stringify(state, null, "\t")}\n`);
	console.log(name, "events", store.events.length, "commands", ran.length);
}
